verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabhanaa saahib ik hai dhoojee jai na hoi na hogee|

en.bdb: The master of all is one; any body else has neither existed nor ever shall be in future.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਰਮਹੰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਚੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: sahaj sarovar paramaha(n)s gurmat motee maanak chogee|

en.bdb: The creatures living in the tank of equipoise of the wisdom of Guru are known as param halls (swans of highest order)and they pick up only rubies and pearls i.e. they always adopt goodness in their life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਜਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਣੁ ਭਜਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਧੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: kheer neer jiau kooR sach tajan bhajan gur giaan adhogee|

en.bdb: Like separating milk from water, discern truth from falsehood, and immerse yourself in the wisdom of the Guru’s teachings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਪਰਿਹਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: eik man ik araadhanaa parihar dhoojaa bhaau dharogee|

en.bdb: Repudiating the sense of duality they adore the one Lord with single mindedness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਘਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g sahaj samaadh agaadh gharogee|

en.bdb: Although house holders, they, merging their consciousness in Word, in the holy congregation remain established ineffortless concentration

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਪਰਮਪਰ ਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)man maranahu baahare paraupakaar paramapar jogee|

en.bdb: Such perfect yogis are benevolent and free from transmigration.
Among such persons is Guru Ram Das who is fully absorbed in Guru Amar Das i.e. he is his constituent.
